title: Sea God Falls for His Sacrifice
desc: Ayla, a young woman ill‑treated by her birth family, is trapped aboard a cruise ship when the brutal sea god Chaos unleashes his deadly trials. Gifted with the power to see emotions as colors, she soothes his age‑old wound with her heartbeat, rising from mere sacrifice to his special one. She fights the jealous siren Siren and her cruel kin, surviving an illusion built around the seven deadly sins. Ayla abandons divinity to save her beloved and defeats an ancient Titan foe — yet Titan threats linger, and fresh danger looms.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Royal Blood & Mafia Knight 2
desc: Just when Caleb and Arian believe their battles are over, fate puts their love to its greatest test yet. As Andrew’s reign threatens both the Crown and Europe’s underworld, they must risk everything to defeat him—and protect their hard-won future.
author: tiktok_drama

title: My Cowboy Billionaire Husband
desc: Betrayed by her fiancé and sister on her wedding day, Nancy is forced to marry a seemingly poor rancher and raise his five children. But her new husband is secretly the billionaire chairman of ND Group! As her jealous family schemes to ruin her, Nancy discovers true love and a life of luxury she never imagined. With her powerful husband and five adorable stepchildren by her side, she's ready to fight back and make everyone who betrayed her regret it!
author: tiktok_drama

title: A Kraken Stole Me on My Wedding Day!
desc: On her wedding day, Emily is swept away by Kairo, a mysterious sea monster with a surprisingly gentle heart. What begins with fear turns into an extraordinary romance filled with laughter, love, and family. But when ruthless hunters threaten their happiness, they must fight to protect the ones they love.
author: tiktok_drama

title: My Mighty Bodyguard
desc: Summary: Fia Ashford is a farm girl with extraordinary strength. To pay for her adoptive father's surgery, she takes a job as the personal bodyguard of Thane Ost, a wealthy CEO who lost the use of his legs in a car crash and has locked himself away for three years. Fia breaks down his walls, forces him into the sunlight, and trains him to walk again. The two slowly fall in love. As Thane stands on his own feet, they uncover the truth: his cousin Lester caused the crash and murdered Thane's mother. At the anniversary gala, Fia protects Thane from armed attackers and helps bring Lester down. Crossing the gap between their two worlds, Fia and Thane build a life together.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Oops! My Poor Rancher Husband Is a Secret Billionaire!
desc: On her wedding day, Nancy is betrayed by both her fiancé and her younger sister. Forced by her parents to marry a supposedly poor rancher, she expects a humble life as the stepmother of his five children. But she soon discovers that her husband is actually the billionaire chairman of ND Group! As her own family continues to humiliate and scheme against her, Nancy grows stronger with her husband’s unwavering support and the love of their five children. In the end, she reclaims her dignity and finds the love and happiness she deserves.
author: tiktok_drama

title: 777: Blessed Rebirth
desc: A man who dies with exactly $777 to his name is granted a second chance by the gods and sent back to his high school years. Guided by divine signs, he begins building his fortune through investments while protecting the kindhearted girl he once overlooked.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Neighbor Has Been Watching My Sister
desc: Daisy is reborn with memories of her past life. She knows their neighbor Andy, who looks like a little boy, is actually an adult predator. In her previous life, Andy stalked and harassed her sister Ida and destroyed her life. This time, Daisy tries her best to expose his disguise and warn Ida. Together with Richard and Detective Miller, they gather evidence of stalking, track down the mastermind Victor, fight against the criminal ring, protect their family, and break free from the nightmare.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Miracle baby: Healing the Vance Family
desc: Abandoned in a forest fire by her greedy father Marcus King for a crate of crystals, infant Maya is rescued and raised by a pack of wolves. Five years later, the 'miracle baby' returns to the city with mysterious healing powers and a silver locket to find her family. However, Marcus, now a wealthy tycoon, cruelly rejects her to protect his social standing and upcoming marriage. While wandering the streets with a stray puppy, Maya crosses paths with Alexander, the powerful head of the Vance family. As secrets of her divine lineage and Marcus's past crimes surface, Maya’s innocence and magical gifts begin to heal a broken dynasty while setting the stage for a dramatic reckoning.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Guard Is Actually An Archmage
desc: To save his sister, fixer Milo fakes a mage license for a night guard job, absorbing Calamity powers by fixing broken exhibits. In the Trial, he defeats foes using grandpa's tools to repair, not kill. When dark mage Valerian strikes, Milo's bloodline awakens. He crushes the plot with God's Anchor, rising as the new Archmage.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Six Years Old Dragon MasterDragon Trainer
desc: Raised by dragons and possessing the extraordinary ability to tame them, Leo descends from the mountains in search of his family. After saving Greta, she tries—but fails—to persuade her mother, Freya, to take him in as a younger brother. When the Black Mountain tribe arrives to seize the Storm Dragon King and forcibly claim Freya as a bride, Leo summons the dragon to defeat them. The truth is finally revealed: Leo is Freya’s long-lost son.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Billionaire's Secret Husband
desc: Dorian Ashcroft, a powerful billionaire CEO, has spent ten years searching for his savior. By chance, he marries vulnerable Elias Wren at City Hall after the young man suffers cruel betrayal. Behind their contract‑based marriage lie hidden fate and deep affection. Under Dorian’s fierce protection and his mother’s support, Elias heals from past trauma, regains his brilliance, and they jointly defeat their vicious enemies, achieving redemptive, passionate love.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Bestie Report: Our Secrets Leaked
desc: BL小说作家苏晚糯与BL漫画师姜知予因车祸意外穿入豪门小说，成为顾家注定惨死的炮灰妯娌——二少奶奶苏晚糯与大少奶奶姜知予。两人不仅解锁双向心声交流外挂，更发现心声能被各自的丈夫顶流影帝顾时和高冷霸总顾琛听见，由此开启一场啼笑皆非的炮灰逆袭之旅。 穿书初期，知晓原书悲惨结局的两人一心想跑路，却因身无分文被迫留下。苏晚糯利用对剧情的预知，戳穿黑粉林薇薇碰瓷顾时的阴谋，用《母猪的产后护理》戏耍索要商业机密的娘家；姜知予则设局摆脱原主纠缠的人，凭借漫画才华开启事业线。过程中，顾时被苏晚糯的明艳飒爽与主动撩拨打动，闷骚本性逐渐暴露；顾琛被姜知予的温柔治愈与丰富内心戏吸引，克制外壳下暗藏占有欲，两对夫妻的感情在拉扯中快速升温。 婆婆张蕙兰误会儿子们的兄弟情，全力助攻两位儿媳，不仅送上贵重首饰，还强制要求夫妻同住，成为两人的最强后盾。期间，许浅、顾小宁、林浅等反派接连作祟，试图破坏她们的婚姻与名声，均被苏晚糯和姜知予联手怼回，甚至让顾时、顾琛主动护妻。两人也从最初的跑路计划，逐渐舍不得顾家的温暖与身边的人。 正当生活趋于安稳时，原书真正的女主宋暖带着系统穿书，主线任务是攻略顾时与顾琛。此时苏晚糯和姜知予已攒够跑路资本，却在收拾行李之际接到宋暖的对接电话，面对带着系统的女主，两人的炮灰逆袭之路迎来最终挑战。全剧以轻松爆笑为基调，融合穿书、心声、甜宠、逆袭等元素，展现现代女性互助成长与真挚爱情的双向奔赴。
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Kingpin Goes Back to School
desc: On the day of his retirement, legendary mafia kingpin Leon 'King' Cross is flattened by Chris, a timid, bullied straight-A student jumping off a building. Following a freak body swap, King vows to fulfill the kid's dying dream: getting into Yale. But to protect his hard-earned 'sacred study sanctuary,' the ruthless godfather rallies his loyal mob crew to obliterate high school bullies with iron fists and maxed-out gangland genius.
author: tiktok_drama

title: My Baby Warns Me
desc: After Vivienne gives birth to her son Noah at the hospital, she unexpectedly gains the ability to hear his inner voice. She learns that her friend Serena conspires with nurse Tanya to swap their babies. She stops the swap in time and exposes Tanya. Later, through Noah’s thoughts, she discovers her husband Adrian has an affair with Serena; the two scheme to seize the family trust fund. Vivienne gathers evidence, reveals their plot publicly at the annual meeting, has them arrested, regains control of the company, and protects her child and her own life.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Billionaire’s Unexpected Husband
desc: When struggling bookstore clerk Noah unexpectedly saves Rose, the matriarch of a powerful billionaire family, the grateful grandmother decides to play matchmaker for her lonely grandson. Determined to test for true love, billionaire heir Victor disguises himself as a broke delivery driver and enters a whirlwind flash marriage with Noah. Caught in a tangled web of secret identities, mutual tests, and escalating external crises, the two unexpectedly fall deeply in love—ultimately learning that only radical honesty can break down their walls and protect each other.
author: tiktok_drama

title: My Wife, The Secret Matriarch
desc: On his wedding day, Caleb Callahan is jilted by his fiancée, and his family is on the verge of bankruptcy. He marries Ava Sullivan. Ava's true identity is the Matriarch of The Dragon Sanctum. She secretly mobilizes resources to protect her husband, while Caleb Callahan treats her with sincerity. Together, the couple fights off various forces and rebuilds the family business.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Jack‘d Up
desc: Jack‘d Up
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Silent Clan Head's Scent
desc: Mei Yu finds Hunter Shaw with a baby. To overturn her parents' verdict, Mei becomes the Young Master's wet nurse in Shaw Manor. She's drawn to Hunter Shaw, the Clan Head, who has aphasia, the man she saved that snowy night. Hunter becomes attached to Mei. He protects her. A paternity test reveals Hunter is the father of her 'stolen' child, who is alive. Hunter, after thirty years of aphasia, speaks Mei's name when their new child is born.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Heiress Escapes Sharks
desc: Natalie Shaw, the real heiress, returns. Pearl Shaw, the fake heiress, jealous of losing Milo Hale, lures Natalie to a shark-infested sea and pushes her in. Natalie fights for survival against sharks. Milo Hale, her lover, rescues her. Pearl's conspiracy is exposed. Milo is devoted to Natalie; their true love is protected.
author: tiktok_drama

title: My Reborn 80s Bride
desc: Clara Clayton, betrayed by a fake heiress, died miserably. Reborn on the day of her substitute marriage in the 1980s, she married Connor Grant. Connor Grant protected her, his two motherless children relied on her. Clara discovered her bride price was stolen, past suffering no accident. She will uncover the truth, protect her family, expose the fake heiress, lead the Grant family out of poverty, turn their cold house into a warm home, winning back all she lost.
author: tiktok_drama

title: I Can Hear My Billionaire Ex's Baby's Thoughts!
desc: His fiancée stole Ivy's newborn. Then her billionaire ex hired her as the baby's nanny. Eight months ago, Ivy was told her son died. Now Ronan's heir reaches for her and cries, “Mommy!” She even hears his thoughts: “Mommy, the bad lady scares me!” When Scarlett frames her for hurting the baby, Ronan takes Scarlett's side. But the DNA test reveals who the real mother is. Ivy flees with her son—leaving the billionaire desperate to get them back. Would you forgive him?
author: tiktok_drama

title: World's Strongest Loser!
desc: Tim Harper is secretly Titan, but at school he's a bullied new kid. His powers keep nearly slipping out, and Sarah suspects his double life. Their bond grows through a talent show and a scholarship contest run by billionaire Blackwell, secretly Tim's mentor. Confessing his secret costs Tim his powers. Mayor Hunter and Jax frame him at a gala, and a blast nearly kills everyone. Powerless, Tim risks his life anyway, regains his powers, and flies off with Sarah as the villains are arrested.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Ice-Cold Billionaire’s Substitute Bride
desc:
Ivy Blake married a billionaire under her twin sister’s name. The deal? Play the perfect wife, collect the money, and leave when her sister recovers. Easy—except her husband is gorgeous, ice-cold, and determined to keep his hands to himself.
Ethan Mercer thinks his elegant wife is the safest way to avoid falling in love. Then he starts hearing her thoughts.
Behind that sweet smile? A very dirty mind—and big plans for those abs.
Suddenly, his carefully controlled marriage is full of dirty fantasies, secret schemes, and jealousy he refuses to admit. His outrageous mother wants grandkids, Ivy wants a husband who actually touches her, and Ethan’s precious self-control is falling apart.
But somewhere between the teasing and the kisses, this fake marriage starts feeling dangerously real. He’s falling for a woman who was never meant to be his bride. What happens when he learns he fell for the wrong twin?
author: tiktok_drama

title: My Sickly Tycoon Husband
desc: She marries the wheelchair-bound “poor boy” everyone despises, never knowing he is actually the richest man in the world. When he stands up at their wedding, everyone who laughed at her begins to panic.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Sample-Size Girlfriend
desc: The Sample-Size Girlfriend
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Sight That Makes Billionaires
desc: Six years ago, Nora rejected Cole’s proposal and concealed her pregnancy, believing their love would stand in the way of his racing dreams. Now a single mother and entertainment reporter, she reunites with him after he becomes a five-time world racing champion. An interview brings buried feelings and painful misunderstandings back to the surface—but Nora still hides the daughter they share. When Ivy is critically injured and needs a rare blood type, Cole abandons his race to save her. As the truth emerges, can they reclaim the family and future they lost?
author: tiktok_drama

title: I Catfished the Mafia King: Love Behind a Fake Name
desc: After six months of online romance using a fake name and edited photos, plus-size college student Harper panics and blocks her boyfriend before they can meet. Then she moves in with her best friend for spring break—and discovers that her friend's older brother, feared mafia boss Dominic Valenti, is the man she ghosted. Her familiar voice and piano playing draw him closer, making her secret harder to hide. Caught between an old crush, campus cruelty, and growing feelings for Dominic, will Harper keep hiding behind “Stella,” or find the courage to pursue love as herself?
author: tiktok_drama

title: Shellie's Seaside Found Family
desc: Five-year-old Shellie is familiar with the sea and exceptionally sensitive to the movements of fish in the ocean, but she was left alone on a desert island by her biological parents. Sean, a poor fisherman, accidentally rescues the helpless Shellie and decides to take good care of the child despite his tight finances. April, a kind and independent woman, feels sorry for Shellie's experience and chooses to stand by Sean's side. The three of them face neighborhood disputes and family conflicts one after another in daily life, protecting and healing each other. Shellie slowly opens up under warm companionship, and the whole family relies on hard work to build and run their ordinary but happy life together.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Billionaire's Belated Regret
desc: Liora Wade traveled across time for Alistair Yates, witnessed him proposing to Serena Sterling when she was pregnant. This failed relationship left their son Leo Wade terminally ill. To save Leo, she returns, accepting to be hurt by Alistair Yates a hundred times. She disappears after enduring all hundred instances of pain. Alistair Yates uncovers the truth, wakes up to his mistake, atones for his sins, and is left with lifelong regret.
author: tiktok_drama

title: I'm Not Your Free Maid
desc: Maren shares an apartment with three roommates, cooking and cleaning daily for only a small grocery fee. When new roommate Tessa arrives, she wins everyone over with “free dinners,” making them believe Maren has been scamming them. After Maren moves out, Tessa’s promised meals turn out to be lies—leftovers make them sick, and they’re forced to do the chores themselves. They finally realize Maren did a year of unpaid labor and left them with one line: “Now it’s your turn to do it yourselves.” Maren starts her own meal business; the roommates learn to clean up their own mess.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Deep-Sea Bride
desc: A squid attacks Aaron's ocean wedding; his bride flees, but a deep-sea being, Sera, drags him under. Sera is no monster—she shifts between human and colossal squid, binding Aaron with a life-bond pearl. Forced together, Aaron learns Sera carries their child, a truth tied to his father, the clans and a royal claim. As Black Reef hunts the pearl and baby, they fight through a rift abyss to save their child. In the end, Aaron and Sera defeat him and return ashore to marry as they choose.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Nail And Prejudice
desc: In a fantasy‑modern New York where status is decided by magical head‑growing nails, true heiress Seraphina is swapped at birth and forced to live as a low‑rank servant. She uncovers the huge swap conspiracy, fights fake heiress Vivian and powerful mastermind Lady Isabella, smashes unfair class rules and wins back her birthright.
author: tiktok_drama

title: I Tipped the Mafia Don
desc: Sebastian Sterling, a defiant actor, spends a wild night with a mysterious stranger, Nikolai Volkov. Unaware of Nikolai’s identity as a ruthless Mafia Godfather, Sebastian leaves a tip and claims to be married before vanishing. The situation turns chaotic when Sebastian’s sham husband, Arthur, drags him to a gala to beg for protection from his powerful uncle—none other than Nikolai himself. As secrets unravel and pheromones ignite, Nikolai is determined to reclaim the "kitten" who dared to treat him like a call-boy. Caught between a failing marriage and a dangerous obsession, Sebastian must navigate a world of power and passion where the Godfather always gets what he wants.
author: tiktok_drama

title: My Mountain God Son-In-Law
desc: Mia Jensen visits the shrine to pray, hoping to find a Lord Husband. She confides in the stone statue, only to discover the statue, Hendrix Stone, is a Mountain God who wakes up. A year later, Mia is pregnant. Hendrix Stone vows to keep her safe, promising to stay together for all lifetimes.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Betrayed Wife's Revenge
desc: Zara Wilson witnessed Jasper Hale's betrayal. She tricked him into signing the Divorce Agreement. When the Cooling-off Period ended, she told him, "Jasper Hale, I don't want you anymore. Get out of my world." Jasper was stunned, tearing up the agreement, "Who said we're getting divorced? I disagree!" Xavier Carter, a powerful tycoon, kept running into her. At a banquet, she pulled his tie. He whispered, "Your ex-husband is watching. Are you sure you want to be this bold?"
author: tiktok_drama

title: Identity Unveiled, Love Found
desc: 萨玛是被养父母苛待长大的孤女，五个月前在惠特莫尔酒店被人陷害后误入朱利安房间，共度一晚后怀上三胞胎。她独自在街头打多份工维生，却不知朱利安正是纽约SterlingGlobal的CEO，且因那夜之事全城寻她。命运的齿轮在内衣摊前转动——朱利安的车队经过，两人对视却未能相认。为应付催婚的祖母埃莉诺，朱利安在酒吧抓住逃跑的萨玛，当场宣布娶她为妻。 这场始于契约的婚姻，让萨玛住进豪宅，却也让两人陷入更深的纠葛。朱利安发现萨玛手腕上的Sterling家族手链，正是他当夜留下的信物；萨玛却坚信那夜之人只是酒店服务员。祖母埃莉诺对萨玛百般疼爱，而朱利安的青梅竹马西耶娜则因嫉妒屡次陷害——从职场伤害到设计泼水滑倒，再到绑架萨玛欲害其腹中胎儿，恶行层层升级。 更复杂的漩涡接踵而至：西耶娜冒认惠特莫尔家族失散千金身份，萨玛的亲生父母爱德华与戴安娜竟将西耶娜错认；萨玛得知朱利安正是三胞胎生父后，为保护他的商业帝国选择默默离开，签下离婚协议远走松林谷镇。朱利安发疯般寻妻，全球发布悬赏；而西耶娜的DNA骗局、凯尔西的伤害，让萨玛在绝境中独自面对生产危机。 当朱利安终于找到萨玛，当惠特莫尔夫妇发现真相，当所有谎言被戳穿——萨玛从被践踏的底层孤女，蜕变为两大豪门珍视的掌上明珠。而朱利安用一场盛大求婚，将契约变为真心。剧集以甜虐交织的节奏，讲述一个关于身份、救赎与真爱的故事：最珍贵的从不是血脉与财富，而是穿越误解依然坚定的守护。
author: tiktok_drama

title: My Husband’s a Wolf, I’m a Husky
desc: Kellan, a homeless husky shifter, disguises himself as a wolf and asks Torin, a powerful black wolf, for shelter. To secure a home, he boldly becomes Torin’s “wife.” Their unusual arrangement soon develops into a sweet, funny romance. But as Kellan’s secret identity faces exposure, the two must learn to trust each other and choose to stay together.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Reborn Heiress: Backed by My Billionaire
desc: Murdered after sacrificing everything for her ungrateful boyfriend Tyler and scheming rival Vanessa, hidden billionaire heiress Serena Vance is reborn into her senior year with a thirst for vengeance. Ruthlessly reclaiming her millions and destroying Vanessa's stolen glory on stage, Serena runs straight to Julian Sterling—the fierce Wall Street heir who died avenging her in their past life. Shielded by Julian’s obsessive devotion and her family’s immense power, Serena unmasks her mother’s true killer, crushes her enemies into dust, and reclaims her rightful crown beside the man who loved her across lifetimes.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Little Prophet
desc: Before the tsunami swallowed the beach, five-year-old Emily had already seen it all. Her mother believed her and rushed her into a life raft, while her stepfather Daniel fled alone, abandoning them both. On the floodwaters, they rescued Captain Austin and set off for the ark in a modified RV. Daniel joined a gang of robbers and hunted them down, yet Emily's visions kept everyone one step ahead—until she watched the people who refused to believe her get buried by a mudslide. When the second wave struck early, Marianne pressed the button and left Daniel, who had turned his back on his family, outside the floodgate. The Noah surged through the towering waves into the morning light, and the three of them stood at the bow, finally a real family.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Dark Tycoon's Sunflower
desc: Wren Sherwood is challenged to "pick a random private room, find a man, and take his belt." Jared Hale's world was darkness until Wren burst in, knelt before him and yanked his belt off. Repeated encounters feel like fate's bond. She is unapologetic, he is helpless. Later, he kneels willingly to put shoes on her, swearing allegiance: "Thank you for bringing light. I will guard my sun well."
author: tiktok_drama

title: Lion’s Choice
desc: Aurelia is pushed off a cliff by her lover and best friend. The golden‑winged lion king Leontes saves her, demanding she bear his heirs. Trapped in his magical kingdom, she gives birth to two lion‑shifter kids. Though once controlled, she fights for freedom and consent. Gradually, Leontes unlearns tyranny. Between escape and fragile love, the human woman finally chooses him by her own will.
author: tiktok_drama

title: I Came Back With His Son
desc: Pregnant heiress Evelyn discovers her husband Victor has an affair with her best‑friend Madison. On the day after her father’s funeral, she is betrayed and pushed off a 300‑foot cliff. Trapped in a narrow cliff‑side cave with scarce supplies, she survives rockfalls, cold and smoke harassment, and secretly gives birth to her son Noah. Victor and Madison keep hunting to eliminate her and the baby, blocking official rescue and fabricating false evidence to seize her family enterprise Hart Group. With limited resources and great physical pain, Evelyn hides and fights back. Her mother Margaret and loyal ally Adrian risk everything to dig up forged documents and recorded proof. Finally, the culprits’ own confessions bring them to justice. Evelyn regains control of the company and builds a safe new life for herself and her child.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Crown of Scorched Crust
desc: In a world where the pizza on your head seals your fate, Chloe enters life with an iron box welded over hers. From birth, her mother swore a desperate vow: no hand, not even her father's, may lift the lid before she turns eighteen. At the elite academy, she is mocked as the blank crust, a shameful daughter beside Serina, her dazzling twin and the family heir. Playboy Marco fakes affection, wagering he can coax her to unlock the box. A jealous classmate locks her in an industrial oven; the heat cracks the seam, spilling golden light. Serina guards her fiercely, but Chloe misreads protection as envy. Burning to prove herself, she enters the Great Pizza Shaping Contest and, bare-handed, reshapes a charred ruin of dough into a masterpiece, winning title after title as Serina risks her fortune to shield her. Yet victory draws the Black Food Consortium, the hidden force behind a banned human experiment twenty years ago. Her father trades her for profit, and the syndicate lays siege to the school. Near death, Rayne and her sister lead her through the underground tunnels, where her mother's old experiment records surface: Chloe is a supreme-grade pizza. The family's private army arrives, the consortium crumbles, and her father is sent to prison. On the night of her coming-of-age ceremony, she lifts the box herself, revealing a Hawaiian Supreme Pizza that stuns the hall. From campus joke to the world's most treasured pizza, she declares at last: the box never defined me, I do.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Lord Nether's Stubborn Fiancee
desc: Tristan Lane, the Lord of the Nether Prison known as Lord Nether, returns to his home country to protect his childhood friend Nina Sterling after she is attacked overseas. The two have a childhood engagement arranged from a young age. Nina is obsessed with the mysterious Lord Nether, but only views Tristan as an ordinary security guard, and is fully resistant to their engagement. Nina holds the core technology Dragon Chip, which has attracted the covetous attention of various forces. Tristan easily takes down a group of thugs, nearly exposing his identity as Lord Nether, but Nina still does not believe his true identity. The main villain from Kyoto kidnaps Nina's parents to coerce her into surrendering the Dragon Chip. Tristan secretly mobilizes global consortium forces, defeats numerous martial arts experts, displays his full power as Lord Nether, eradicates all forces of the Four Great Clans, and his identity is completely exposed. Nina finally realizes the truth, and stays together with Tristan.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Five Little Babies Find Their Billionaire Daddy a Bride!
desc:
Widowed billionaire Ethan has everything money can buy, except someone to share his life with. Determined to find their father a new wife, his five children take matters into their own hands and introduce him to Emma, a warmhearted, fiercely independent supermarket worker.

Intrigued by her sincerity, Ethan hides his fortune and poses as an ordinary working-class man, hoping to discover whether Emma can love him for who he is rather than what he owns. As their unexpected romance blossoms, Emma faces battles of her own, standing up to her controlling, sexist stepfather and helping her mother escape a miserable marriage.

But when Ethan's billionaire identity is finally exposed, Emma feels deeply betrayed. Can their growing love survive a lie built on good intentions? Despite her heartbreak, Emma eventually finds the courage to forgive him, without sacrificing her independence. Determined to build a career on her own merits rather than her husband's wealth, she proves that true happiness comes not from money or status, but from love, self-respect, and a family worth fighting for.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Wrong Tyrant Marriage：My Bestie & I Swap Husbands
desc: Modern sea queen Flora and genius scholar Charlotte are inseparable besties. Somehow, they accidentally get transported into a Western fantasy novel and end up as cannon-fodder human princesses married off to dragon princes. To earn the system’s billion-dollar reward and revive in the real world, they have to win over the icy crown prince Sebastian and the oceanic second prince Theodore in just three months. Unexpectedly, they find out that they actually have to woo each other’s husbands! Using their modern scientific knowledge and top-notch romance tactics, Flora and Charlotte shine in the danger-filled dragon palace. Facing the original novel's heroine Ada’s constant schemes and vicious traps, the two besties team up and use their intelligence to turn the tables on all plots. Over time, the two tyrant princes completely fall for them. In the end, Flora and Charlotte return to reality and reunite with Sebastian and Theodore in the modern world, bringing everything to a perfect conclusion.
author: tiktok_drama

title: I TURNED TRASH INTO A BILLION-DOLLAR EMPIRE
desc: Bullied at a luxury estate, a broke foreclosure cleaner gains X-ray vision in his blind eye from a crystal shard. Seeing hidden vaults and every object's true value, he turns scrap and a burned-out motel bought at auction into legendary riches, outwits his enemies, and becomes a tycoon who conquers both wealth and romance.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Dumped Son, Chosen Mom
desc: Six‑year‑old Jasper is discarded by his birth mother Leah, who only kept him for child‑support payments. Traumatized and people‑pleasing, he arrives at his birth father Gray’s mansion, constantly living in fear of making mistakes and being abandoned again. His kind‑hearted step‑mother Ella sees through his hidden pain and gives him unconditional love and protection. Patiently, she teaches him that he deserves care without having to be useful. As Leah repeatedly returns to manipulate, threaten and fight for custody, the little boy gradually breaks free from deep‑rooted trauma. He grows from a timid, self‑abased child into a brave youth. After bitter courtroom confrontations, the family wins full guardianship of Jasper. Bound by chosen affection rather than blood, the three of them build a warm, healing home and embrace genuine family happiness.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Off‑Side Heartbeat
desc: To prove Victor Reed killed his parents, Adrian Wells accepts Richard Reed's offer to lead Sterling Group—on one condition: tame his vicious son Chase. Adrian finds Chase a razor-edged rival, yet Chase falls for him while Adrian hunts Victor's crime. Four lives entangle, where intimacy and danger walk hand in hand, and every opening hides a knife.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Billionaire Daddy, I'm Your Little Elf!
desc: Three-and-a-half-year-old Luna arrives at billionaire heir Arthur Winston's engagement party with only one clue to her father's identity: a Winston family cufflink. Arthur, who has lost all memory of his past love, believes the child may be part of a scheme—until a paternity test proves Luna is truly his daughter. As Luna enters the Winston family, her warmth and innocence slowly transform the once-cold household and teach Arthur how to become a real father. But Luna carries another secret: she has inherited magical elven blood from her mother, Leah, allowing her to connect with nature and heal plants. As Luna's powers emerge and Arthur's lost memories return, he discovers that Leah is the woman he once loved—and an elven queen.
author: tiktok_drama

title: From Sacrifice to the Alpha's Luna
desc:
"Ivy Blackwood, a scorned bastard daughter, is chosen as the virgin sacrifice to the forest’s terrifying “man-eating beast”. Fleeing for her life, she encounters Kane—a brooding, reclusive stranger plagued by a 500-year-old curse.

They strike a marriage of convenience: Ivy stays by his side to soothe his torment, and Kane grants her safety and a new home. Brought to the grand werewolf estate, she faces scorn, betrayal, and deadly plots from the power-hungry Red, who covets the Alpha throne.

As hidden truths unravel, Ivy discovers Kane is the legendary thousand-year Wolf King, and the real monster behind the sacrifices has hidden in plain sight. From a doomed sacrifice to the Alpha’s fated Luna, true love becomes the only key to breaking the ancient curse."
author: tiktok_drama

title: Bouquet of Rebirth: Sushi Royal Revenge
desc:
Murdered by her envious sister Salmon and tormented by her brutal husband Wes, Cali opens her eyes once more at the Sushi family's bouquet ceremony, where fate grants everyone a second chance. Salmon, reborn alongside her, seizes the bouquet and weds Wes, convinced she has claimed the Michelin five-star destiny that belonged to Cali. Aware of Wes's cruelty, Cali quietly lets her sister have him. Shoved aside, Cali's bouquet tumbles into the arms of Soyer — a scruffy, cheap soy-sauce sachet hiding a royal secret — and she accepts his hand despite her family's mockery and disownment.
While Salmon and Wes sneer at the pair, Soyer shields Cali in silence, lets slip glimpses of royal blood, and fastens a black-diamond bracelet to her wrist. Her parents and sister heap abuse upon her, until Wes's sadistic streak turns against Salmon herself. As royal guards hunt for the missing prince and his mother falls ill, Soyer keeps his identity buried. Cali joins the royal Michelin competition. Poison meant for her is swapped by Soyer's loyal servant, so Cali sails through the preliminaries while Wes suffers public humiliation. Vengeful Salmon then taints Cali's rice before the final. Soyer crushes the poisoned ingredient to expose the plot and nearly dies on the scaffold for impersonating the prince — until the King and Queen arrive, reveal his true identity, and pass judgment on the conspirators.
Testing Cali, the Queen asks her to cook from scraps; her magnificent dish wins the crown's r
author: tiktok_drama

title: My Husband Never Registered My Death！！
desc:
Three years after her death, Rey (the female lead, nicknamed "Little Chili") is still queuing to enter Heaven; she is informed that her husband has not yet filed her death certificate. Furious, Rey returns to the mortal world to confront Ronan (the male lead).

Ronan appears to be a cold, ruthless CEO, but deep down, he is a coward. Unaware of the truth, he encounters various supernatural events in his villa—scenes that pay homage to classic American horror films like *The Shining*—which are actually Rey’s way of leaving him messages and accusations. Ronan hires an exorcist at great expense to banish the "evil spirit" haunting the villa, only to discover that the spirit is his own late wife. The two communicate by writing messages in the steam on mirrors, trading accusations.

Ronan accuses Rey of turning into a malevolent spirit intent on harming him. Rey accuses Ronan of using her death to cultivate a "devoted husband" persona while failing to file her death certificate, thereby preventing her from ascending to Heaven.

To get rid of Rey (though his true intention is to help her ascend), Ronan immediately files her death certificate. While they wait, Ronan asks why she left final messages for everyone else but not for him. Rey has a flashback to the time she raised their child alone while Ronan neglected his family for his work.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Mafia's Littlest Boss
desc:
Mia is a tiny three-and-a-half-year-old orphan with a big attitude, always dressed in her yellow bee hoodie. When rich couples come to the orphanage shopping for a perfect child, the spoiled and arrogant Mrs. Coleman cruelly rejects every kid—including Sophie, a limping little girl. Mia, no taller than a plastic stool, climbs up, pokes the rude man's belly, and defends her friend: "Bad guy! Sophie pretty, you ugly!"

Meanwhile, reclusive mafia boss Julian Blackwood has spent years searching for the daughter he lost. A chance encounter leads him to Sunshine Children's Home, where he meets the fearless little girl in the bee hoodie. Through tantrums, sticky candies, and adorable chaos, Mia wins over her cold, grieving father and his entire crew of stone-faced bodyguards. Julian must confront his past, face rival families, and protect his daughter—all while trying not to cry every time she says, "No more tears, Daddy."

A heartwarming comedy about the world's toughest crime boss being completely bossed around by his tiniest, bee-obsessed little girl.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Alpha CEO's Omega Superstar
desc: S-class Alpha tycoon Xavier and Omega top actor Evan were childhood sweethearts, but a misunderstanding in their youth turned them into arch-enemies. At a business party, Evan was drugged and went into heat, and Xavier marked him on the spot, sparking a scandal. Following the clues, the two uncover a conspiracy involving gangs and Evan’s uncle, facing kidnappings, online harassment crises, and battles for career and corporate power, eventually resolving their childhood issues. Despite opposition from family elders and dealing with a terminally ill relative, the two support each other through the stress, overcome a misdiagnosis mix-up, and eventually get married, with Evan winning an international Best Actor award, achieving a mutually committed HE ending.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Don's Dragon Heir
desc: Deep in the Alps lies the Sacred Grove, home to ancient dragons. Faced with deadly underworld erosion, silver dragon Caelan drains magic from mafia don Dante Moretti to survive, accidentally conceiving their daughter Lyra. Five years later, the ailing Caelan and sharp‑witted little Lyra head to the human world to find Dante.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Oops, The Ace And Mini-Me Ruled the Skies
desc:
A shattered windshield at 30,000 feet. The captain faints. The one steering the doomed flight? A six-year-old girl.
Guided only by her father’s radio commands, the child pulls off a miracle landing. But the cowardly captain steals the credit, becoming a national hero overnight, and uses her billionaire fiancé to silence the father and daughter forever.
They think Leo is just a lowly air traffic controller they can easily crush.
They have no idea he is a retired ace pilot. And to protect his little girl, the god of the skies is about to unleash hell.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Late Summer Heat
desc: Ethan Carter is a genius cellist and a cast-off omega — dumped by his fiancé for his own half-brother, drugged and nearly assaulted on the night he's disowned. Fever-blind, he stumbles into a stranger's Rolls-Royce and wakes up married. Four years later he returns with a toddler, a terminal diagnosis, and a quiet plan: win the music competition, leave the prize money to his son and his "poor bodyguard husband," then die without a fuss. He doesn't know the bodyguard is Adrian Hayes — the hidden billionaire behind the city's most powerful group, the boy who pinky-promised to marry him in childhood, and the alpha whose pheromones match his at 98%. Now the ex-fiancé regrets everything. The rival brother plays dirty. A disguised grandmother is matchmaking. And when his glands begin to fail, the richest man in the country is about to show the world what "marked for life" really means.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Great White Dark Waters
desc: Serena is forced to marry her family's enemy to save her brother. Trapped in a contract marriage with Mafia boss Roman, she uncovers a deadly conspiracy and joins him to destroy the empire behind their blood feud.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Plus-Size Girl He Dumped Is a Billion-Dollar Heiress
desc: For seven years, Selena Hale hides her identity as a billionaire heiress to support her boyfriend, Ethan. But when she discovers his affair with his boss, Olivia, everything changes. Humiliated and betrayed, Selena walks away and returns to her powerful family, determined to reclaim her life. As Ethan and Olivia continue to mock and sabotage her, they have no idea the woman they discarded controls a billion-dollar empire. Meanwhile, Selena catches the attention of Liam Sterling, a handsome billionaire CEO who loves her for who she truly is. With shocking identity reveals, ruthless revenge, jealous rivals, and unexpected romance, Selena turns every humiliation into a stunning comeback. But when her enemies become desperate enough to destroy her happiness, will Selena finally get the love and justice she deserves?
author: tiktok_drama

title: Just a Miner? I’m the Sorceress Queen’s Daughter!
desc: Karen, a Sanctum princess. Forced apart from her mother Isabella, the Sorceress Queen, by a childhood blood pact, Karen endures twenty‑year hardship in the Ashen Town mines. She is betrayed by her five‑year partner Julian, who steals her hard‑won magic design and humiliates her at a public ceremony. At the critical moment, Isabella, who has spent two decades searching for her daughter, arrives to protect her. After overcoming schemes from multiple villains including High Elder Ignatius, mother and daughter are reunited. Karen’s true identity as the Sanctum princess is revealed, wrong‑doers are punished, and the pair gain a happy ending.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Plus-Size Girl Who Took Over the Cheer Squad
desc: After failing cheer tryouts at Roosevelt High, Selena sets a 100day goal. She trains relentlessly to build strength and cheer skills and gains likeminded allies. Faced with all kinds of difficulties from original captain Blanca, Selena refuses to fight cruelty with cruelty. Staying true to herself, she values teamwork and mutual protection. She discovers overlooked teammates and breaks narrow beauty stereotypes. After fierce competitions and twists, Selena leads her underestimated partners to the national finals. She interprets the true meaning of strength, wins glory for herself and the team, and embarks on a new romantic journey.
author: tiktok_drama

title: IRON CROWN
desc: In a world where flower crowns embody inherited legacy, Emily Cole has been trapped beneath an enigmatic iron helmet from the moment she was born, hiding who she truly is. Her twin sister Rose, by contrast, thrives as the revered heir of the Cole line, adorned with an immaculate white rose. Bound by her mother’s grave promise that the helmet will only release its hold on Emily’s eighteenth birthday, she bears the weight of others’ bias with quiet fortitude. At the grand inauguration of Northridge Academy, Rose basks in public admiration while Emily remains alone on the sidelines—until Julian, the academy’s most distinguished student whose crown bears the rare Black Datura, makes an unheard-of gesture of reverence: he presents her with the fabled Spirit Dew. The crowd falls silent, and wild rumors quickly spread. What staggering secret lies locked under the iron? As her eighteenth birthday draws near, Emily is about to uncover a truth that will reshape the meaning of legacy, devotion, and value itself. It will reveal that genuine nobility grows from bravery, not blooming blossoms.
author: tiktok_drama

title: She faked ugly to test love
desc: To test whether men value inner qualities over looks, wealthy heiress Liora deliberately disguises herself as an unattractive plain‑looking girl. By accident she meets cold trillion‑dollar conglomerate CEO Alaric, who has been betrayed by many beautiful ex‑girlfriends. After they catch their cheating partners at a café, Alaric publicly proposes to Liora and they enter a contract engagement. She faces mockery from his arrogant teenage brother, snobbery at high‑end bridal shops and unreasonable oppression from her biased birth family. Gradually genuine affection grows between the pair. On their wedding day Liora removes her ugly disguise, revealing her breathtaking true appearance and real heiress identity. The cheating ex‑lovers get their comeuppance. This is a romantic comedy about pretense, trust and love that sees beyond outer beauty.
author: tiktok_drama

title: From the Dead to System Queen
desc: When the zombie apocalypse hit, Chloe's parents were killed by her uncle for their fortune, and she was locked out to die in the horde. But she wakes up seven days before it all begins, along with her mom and dad. This time, she extorts five million from her wicked uncle, stockpiles like crazy, seals the doors shut, and unlocks unlimited quantum storage. Now it's her uncle's family begging at her door!
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Superpowered Twins
desc: When superpowered twins Luna and Leo rescue paralyzed billionaire Ethan Blackwood from an assassination attempt, they demand a fortune to save their blind mother, Clara. Taking jobs as Ethan’s specialized caregivers at Blackwood Manor, the duo uses their teleportation and super-strength to force the depressed former champion out of his shell. As they discover a champion ring linking Ethan to their mother’s mysterious past, the twins launch a secret paternity mission. Amidst corporate betrayals from Ethan’s cousin and a spiteful ex-fiancée, the twins’ fierce protection reignites Ethan’s will to fight. Together, they must confront the shadows of the past to reclaim their family legacy and restore Ethan's glory in this high-stakes tale of revenge and reunion.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Honest Mooncake Baker
desc: Luna Lane of Cassia Bakery uses quality ingredients. Mara Marsh uses bad ingredients for cheap mooncakes, driving Cassia Bakery out of business. Mara Marsh's mooncakes sicken senior care residents. She repackages old mooncakes in Cassia Bakery boxes, poisons Gu Corporation workers, and frames Luna Lane. Luna Lane proves innocence. Sean Sterling, Boss Walsh, and employees expose the truth; Mara Marsh is investigated. Gavin Grove cooperates with Luna Lane. Cassia Bakery regains public trust.
author: tiktok_drama

title: My Billionaire Boss’s Baby Can Talk to Me
desc: Mia, an orphan, is pregnant and alone until her unborn baby Peanut speaks through his thoughts. He guides her to become a nanny at Logan Estate. There, Mia can hear baby Daisy’s inner voice, saving her from hidden dangers and earning Logan’s trust. Peanut reveals Logan is his father. Mia helps Daisy reunite with Claire and faces Scarlett’s schemes. After Daisy’s kidnapping and Mia’s labor, Peanut is born, and the whole family hears his voice. Finally, they become a true family.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Her Grateful Python Protector
desc: Chloe Sterling marries to a mountain village. Nine months pregnant, she rescues a giant python. The python is grateful and comes to repay her kindness. Just as Chloe is about to give birth, she learns her husband, parents-in-law, and sister-in-law have been acting, their only goal the baby in her womb. Realizing it's a conspiracy, Chloe tries to escape but is caught and in danger. The python arrives to save her.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Time-Traveling Savior
desc: Luke Lawson, in an era of scarcity, supports his mother and siblings. Discovers a jade pendant, travels to modern society. Pendant allows time travel, item storage, time manipulation. Uses old coins/antiques for money, buys supplies for his world to rescue family. Saves refugee Lily, helps neighbors/friends, uses time travel for mutual aid. Proposes building reservoir, stockpiling grain for village, protecting community.
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Interworld Village Savior
desc: During a famine, Mia Lane activates her mother's Magic Storage Sachet, gaining the ability to travel between ancient Breeze Village and the modern world. She brings modern goods to ancient times and ancient goods to the modern world, saving her severely injured father and helping her family survive the famine. Mia leads villagers to develop the village, lifting it out of poverty. A new crisis arrives.
author: tiktok_drama

title: My CEO and His Cleaning Fiancée
desc: 女主误打误撞成为了总裁的未婚妻扮演者，却一直以为自己只是个保姆，总裁本来只是想演戏，最后却发现自己的心已经找到了归属。
author: tiktok_drama

title: My Pet Crocodile Became a Disaster
desc: Left-behind woman Shirley Hale, feeling lonely, privately raises a Siamese Crocodile and treats the wild animal as her own child. Influencer Wren Winslow hypes exotic pets for online traffic, repeatedly feeding the animal incorrectly, which awakens the crocodile's wild instincts and creates a major safety hazard for the entire village. After a series of crisis incidents, everyone comes to their senses, and the crocodile is sent to a professional institution for Wilderness Training. Shirley repents and devotes herself to wildlife science popularization, while her family works together to build a local orchard and rescue station, protecting their hometown and achieving personal redemption.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Perfect Husband, Dead Bedroom
desc: Perfect Husband, Dead Bedroom
author: tiktok_drama

title: Her Curves, His Curse
desc:
Amy, a girl mocked for her appearance, awakens a cursed God-King named Arthur after a painful betrayal. Arthur stays by her side and is captivated by her cooking.
With Arthur’s protection, Amy regains her confidence and fights against judgment and humiliation. But his magic comes with a price, forcing them to discover the true meaning of love and self-acceptance.
author: tiktok_drama

title: Ranch of Love
desc: 是一部聚焦女性成长与家庭和解的都市情感短剧。故事以班尼特家大女儿克洛伊的替嫁命运为起点，展开一段从尘埃到云端的逆袭人生。 克洛伊自幼被父亲亨利忽视，母亲留下的房产成为她唯一的情感寄托。当偏心父亲以房产为要挟，逼迫她代替妹妹斯嘉丽嫁给西部牧场主伊森时，她被迫签下屈辱的婚约交换协议。被管家丢弃在泥泞路边的克洛伊，遇见了驾驶旧皮卡前来的伊森——一个穿着工装、沉默寡言的普通牧场主。然而，这个看似简陋的木屋之家，却藏着令人震惊的秘密：伊森实为海耶斯农业集团的实际掌权人，手握全美西部近三成肉牛供应链与多项农业专利，年净收入数千万美元。他选择隐居牧场，只因热爱土地与简单生活。 伊森的母亲伊莲诺是一位通透睿智的长辈，她一眼便赏识克洛伊的真诚与韧性，赠予名贵珠宝、传授经营之道，更将家族财务大权交予她手。克洛伊从最初的不安与自卑，逐渐成长为能够独当一面的牧场女主人。她学习阅读账册、管理果园、拓展出口业务，在伊森的陪伴下解锁了海耶斯家族庞大的商业版图——从牧场到食品加工厂，从高定珠宝到私人庄园，她一步步找到了自己的价值与位置。 与此同时，嫁给都市富商加勒特的斯嘉丽正走向另一条路。加勒特的沃克商贸公司早已资金链断裂，他娶斯嘉丽只为套取班尼特家的财产。斯嘉丽被虚荣蒙蔽，多次拉着丈夫上门挑衅，污蔑克洛伊偷窃、炫耀自己的豪门生活。当加勒特试图以土地纠纷阻拦镇上公路修建时，伊森凭借合法契约与全镇居民的支持，让加勒特当众颜面尽失。此后，加勒特编造高回报投资谎言，哄骗斯嘉丽掏空父亲积蓄、变卖首饰，最终摊牌离婚。斯嘉丽从云端跌落，一无所有。 走投无路的斯嘉丽曾向克洛伊借钱，却被姐姐拒绝——克洛伊要她学会自己站起来。斯嘉丽在杂货店踏实务工，从笨拙到熟练，从娇纵到坚韧。克洛伊观察到妹妹的改变，心软伸出援手，出资为她租下门店开办面包房。亨利也在此时幡然醒悟，修改遗嘱平分遗产，弥补对大女儿的亏欠。 故事尾声，伊森将家族信托全部划归克洛伊名下，带她解锁私人庄园与高定藏品，并在两人相识的教堂补办盛大婚礼。斯嘉丽担任伴娘，全镇居民到场祝福。克洛伊手握牧场全部产业，与丈夫、婆婆、改过自新的妹妹相伴，在广袤牧场拥有了安稳幸福的人生。
author: tiktok_drama

title: Escape Leviathan: Season 3
desc: To clear his name, Hale Carter learns before Gordon Carter falls to his death that his former secretary Marnie Sloane holds video evidence of Yara Carter colluding with Gordon Carter. Hale goes undercover, entering the offshore Leviathan Prison, where he forms an escape team with Marnie Sloane and her mother Lora Sloane. Working together, they survive the suffocating Water Cell and the laser corridor that offers almost no chance of survival. After countless dangers, Lora and Marnie escape with Hale risking his life to help them. But Hale has barely escaped one trap only to fall into another: Yara Carter throws him into a new prison. Faced with an impenetrable cage, and the murderous intent of guards and inmates surrounding him like hungry wolves, can Hale escape alive once more this time?
author: tiktok_drama

title: The Kraken Took My Groom
desc:
Caleb’s seaside wedding goes straight to disaster — his bride Sloane only tied the knot to get her claws on his father’s old family home. Halfway through the ceremony, a 100-foot giant octopus named Maren rips the boat apart and drags Caleb down to the ocean floor.

Lost in the deep, he unknowingly seals a life-bond with Maren. Gills sprout on his neck, their fates are linked as one, and she’s even carrying his child. The kicker? Maren has waited 50 years to find her long-lost love — who’s actually Caleb’s own 70-year-old father.

When debt-ridden Sloane digs up the truth, she sells Maren out to a ruthless sea-monster hunting outfit. Their family home burns to the ground, Maren is captured and barely hanging on. Caleb risks everything to break her free, but the final showdown looms on the open water. No one can guess how this half-century-old misunderstanding, and the fatal contract binding them, will really end.
author: tiktok_drama

title: MY SON PICKED My WIFE
desc: Ten-year-old Aiden Vandergriff is on a mission to find his dad a new mom. What he doesn't know is that Grant, a billionaire in disguise, is secretly testing women to find one who loves him for himself, not his money. After many failed dates, Aiden meets Claire, a tough truck driver who gives him new shoes and defends him. Claire, a single mom with a daughter, wins Grant's heart. But when Grant's true identity is revealed and greedy relatives threaten their family, Claire and Grant join forces to protect Aiden — and chosen family wins.
author: tiktok_drama
